momentic-ai-skills-mo-qa.description: Run Mo web and mobile QA sessions with the qa CLI. Covers saved environments, mobile builds, private targets, reports, replies, triage, and retests.

momentic-ai-skills-claude-mo-qa.description: Run hosted Mo QA sessions through Momentic's MCP tools. Covers web, mobile builds, GitHub PRs, private Connectors, reports, findings, and retests.

momentic-ai-skills-momentic-maintain.description: Diagnose and classify failing Momentic browser, Android, and iOS tests, compare run history, and repair quarantined tests.

momentic-ai-skills-momentic-spec.description: Specify browser, Android, and iOS behavior with Momentic tests before implementing new or changed features.

momentic-ai-skills-momentic-test.description: Create, run, and maintain Momentic browser, Android, and iOS tests and modules stored as *.test.yaml and *.module.yaml files.
